# MVP Readiness Checklist: PayTrack POS

**Purpose**: Đánh giá độ đầy đủ, rõ ràng, nhất quán và khả năng kiểm chứng của các yêu cầu (requirements quality) cho bản MVP PayTrack POS trước khi triển khai `/speckit-implement`.  
**Created**: 2026-11-16  
**Feature**: [`spec.md`](../spec.md) · [`plan.md`](../plan.md) · [`data-model.md`](../data-model.md) · [`api-and-rpc.md`](../contracts/api-and-rpc.md) · [`DESIGN.md`](../../../DESIGN.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all required fields and default states explicitly defined for the customizable invoice preview toggles (*Công nợ lũy kế*, *VietQR*, `A5` vs `80mm`) across both per-invoice overrides and Shop Settings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are exact rounding and validation rules specified when calculating `line_total` for fractional item quantities (e.g., `0.5 kg`, `1.2 kg` in `order_items.quantity`) so total VND remains an exact integer? [Gap, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the fallback requirements defined when Mom attempts to create a debt order (`paid_amount < total_amount`) without selecting a named customer? [Completeness, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all mandatory bank configuration fields (`bank_bin` 6-digit format, `bank_account_no`, `bank_account_name`) and empty-bank onboarding redirects specified for VietQR generation? [Completeness, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK005 Are profit-calculation visibility rules specified when an order mixes items that have an optional `cost_price` with items whose `cost_price` is `NULL` (e.g., how `profit_tracked_ratio` or partial gross profit is labeled)? [Clarity, Contracts §1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the exact arithmetic formula and historical point-in-time reference for *Công nợ lũy kế* (`previous_customer_debt + order.total_amount - order.paid_amount`) clearly specified for both newly created orders and re-opened historical orders? [Clarity, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the exact morning digest trigger rules (timezone `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`, configurable `reminder_default_hour`, idempotency via `last_digest_sent_date`, and inclusion criteria for `next_due_date <= today`) unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Contracts §2]
- [ ] CHK008 Are VietQR transfer memo sanitization rules (ASCII normalization, uppercase, 25-character cap) clearly specified for Vietnamese customer names with diacritics? [Clarity, Contracts §4]
- [ ] CHK009 Are FIFO debt-allocation rules unambiguously defined when `record_debt_payment` receives a lump-sum payment (`p_order_id IS NULL`) vs a single-order payment (`p_order_id` provided)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do the debt-balance rules align consistently across checkout (`create_order_with_items`), partial repayment (`record_debt_payment`), and order cancellation (`cancel_order`) so `customers.total_debt` never diverges from unpaid order balances? [Consistency, Data Model §3]
- [ ] CHK011 Are typography, color contrast (`>= 4.5:1`), touch-target (`>= 48px` mobile), and banned AI-slop rules consistent between `constitution.md`, `DESIGN.md`, and `Spec §FR-010`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Do the iPhone PWA notification requirements align consistently across `Spec §FR-004`, `Research §3`, and `Contracts §3` regarding Safari `standalone` detection, mandatory visible `showNotification()`, and `Cache-Control: no-cache` for `/sw.js`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]

## Scenario, Edge Case & Recovery Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are recovery and conflict-handling requirements specified when canceling an order (`cancel_order`) that already has partial `debt_payments` recorded against it (including whether paid amounts are refunded/kept as credit or blocked)? [Recovery, Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Are user-facing error and retry requirements specified when a device loses network connectivity mid-checkout or during debt collection (`offline guard`), preventing silent local-only state loss? [Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are stale push subscription cleanup requirements (`HTTP 410 Gone` / `404 Not Found` immediate deletion) and non-blocking delivery behavior defined when one of Mom's registered devices removes the PWA? [Recovery, Contracts §2]
- [ ] CHK016 Are immutable snapshot requirements consistently defined when Mom edits or archives (`is_active = false`) a product's price or `cost_price` after past orders have already been issued? [Edge Case, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK017 Are concurrent multi-device write protections (`FOR UPDATE` row locking) and input boundary validations (`p_amount > total_debt` rejection) fully specified for simultaneous iPhone and Windows usage? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional, Security & Measurable Criteria

- [ ] CHK018 Are RLS isolation requirements (`user_id = auth.uid()`) specified across all 8 database tables and all PostgreSQL RPCs, alongside strict separation of `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` and `CRON_SECRET` from client bundles? [Security, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK019 Are measurable latency, responsiveness, and layout stability criteria (`< 20s` checkout, `<= 2s` Realtime sync, `375px` & `1280px` zero horizontal overflow, `16px+` input font to prevent iOS zoom) quantified in `Spec §Success Criteria` and `DESIGN.md`? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 Are zero-state / empty-state UX requirements defined for first-time sign-in (no products, no customers, no orders, unconfigured bank account, no analytics data yet)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Are print and high-DPI PNG export requirements quantified for Vietnamese font embedding (`Be Vietnam Pro` + `JetBrains Mono`) and `@media print` chrome suppression on both iOS Safari and Windows Chrome/Edge? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Are all platform assumptions and free-tier constraints (Supabase Free `pg_cron` 5-minute polling vs Vercel Hobby daily cron limit, iOS 16.4+ Home Screen PWA requirement) explicitly documented and validated? [Assumption, Research §3]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `CHK002`, `CHK013`, and `CHK020` surface minor `[Gap]` items worth keeping in mind (fractional quantity rounding rule, canceling an order with existing partial repayments, and empty-state guidance on first login).
